scope: Source lineage and original byte identities, not a claim of unchanged deployed tools or inherited test results.
port_changes: Python package-relative imports replace sibling-script imports.
An explicit data root replaces a root inferred from installed tool location.
Public commands isolate engine invocations in child Python processes.
Public canonical writes use an exclusive per-KB lock; reads and previews do not create locks, and stale locks are never removed automatically.
Initialization creates correctly bound empty data without agent-role instructions or a Seed installer.
Guest access and tool verification use the shipped Python package manifest instead of Seed installation receipts or owner-decision records.
Code in KnowledgeBase data directories is not loaded or executed.
Engine and API child processes run Python with -P, so the caller's working directory cannot shadow imports (kb_client.py since 0.2.3).
kb.py adds match strength, coverage-weighted scores and the full-query route bonus from a later source change on top of the v07 third build (0.3.0); match sets are unchanged.
